decisions.question: PR #36 (wave 5) passed every test gate in CI, but the final certification step failed: `npm audit` now reports a new MODERATE advisory published yesterday (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, minimatch < 11.0.1, possible denial of service via glob patterns). minimatch is only a dev-tooling dependency (eslint / typescript-eslint, used by the lint step), not runtime code. Our CI requires zero vulnerabilities at any severity, so this blocks EVERY PR to main until fixed. The only patched version is 11.0.1 (major bump); it keeps the two APIs eslint uses (Minimatch class and minimatch function) and adds 3 small transitive packages (@isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match 1.0.3, brace-expansion 5.0.12, balanced-match 4.0.4). Authorize a package.json `overrides` pin of minimatch to 11.0.1 plus the matching package-lock.json update, verified with a full lint run and the CI bar?
grants: package-lock.json: node_modules/minimatch 10.2.5 → 11.0.1 e o novo node_modules/@isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match 1.0.3 (brace-expansion 5.0.12 e balanced-match 4.0.4 já estavam no lock)
esta mudança de lockfile, limitada ao minimatch e à sua dependência nova, só de ferramenta de desenvolvimento
